stories.title: Nevada Union brings Miner magic in first win of season
stories.summary: Nevada Union (1-1) shook off a sluggish start, pulling away in the second half behind a strong ground game to beat the Wood Wildcats (0-2) of Vacaville, 30-15, Friday night at Hooper Stadium in Grass Valley.

stories.title: Miners Foundry cafe and Broad Street offices open for bids by Nevada City
stories.summary: The City of Nevada City is currently circulating Requests for Proposals (RFP) in regards for the reuse and lease of two city-owned properties.

stories.title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
stories.summary: Britain's foreign secretary accuses settlers of carrying out the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians, as Israel responds by shutting the UK consulate in East Jerusalem.

stories.title: Carney says US trade war 'will come at a cost' as Canada strikes back on tariffs
stories.summary: Canada's levies - as high as 50% - will apply to nearly $20bn of US products, from steel to T-shirts.

stories.title: Renoir paintings worth millions stolen in French museum heist
stories.summary: It is the latest in a string of high-profile art thefts in Europe that has again put the security of museums and galleries in the spotlight.

stories.title: Argentina to file criminal case against oil company operating in Falklands
